# IPsm3
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/sky/IPsm3.sol)

**Title:**
IPsm3

Minimal interface for the Sky PSM3 swap module


## Functions
### previewSwapExactIn

Previews the output amount for an exact-input swap


```solidity
function previewSwapExactIn(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountIn
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 amountOut);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|The asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|The asset being bought|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|The exact input amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|The expected output amount|


### previewSwapExactOut

Previews the input amount required for an exact-output swap


```solidity
function previewSwapExactOut(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountOut
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 amountIn);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|The asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|The asset being bought|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|The exact output amount|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|The required input amount|


### swapExactIn

Swaps an exact input amount for at least a minimum output


```solidity
function swapExactIn(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountIn,
    uint256 minAmountOut,
    address receiver,
    uint256 referralCode
)
    external
    returns (uint256 amountOut);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|The asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|The asset being bought|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|The exact input amount|
|`minAmountOut`|`uint256`|The minimum acceptable output amount|
|`receiver`|`address`|The recipient of the output asset|
|`referralCode`|`uint256`|An optional referral code|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|The output amount received|


### swapExactOut

Swaps up to a maximum input for an exact output amount


```solidity
function swapExactOut(
    address assetIn,
    address assetOut,
    uint256 amountOut,
    uint256 maxAmountIn,
    address receiver,
    uint256 referralCode
)
    external
    returns (uint256 amountIn);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assetIn`|`address`|The asset being sold|
|`assetOut`|`address`|The asset being bought|
|`amountOut`|`uint256`|The exact output amount desired|
|`maxAmountIn`|`uint256`|The maximum acceptable input amount|
|`receiver`|`address`|The recipient of the output asset|
|`referralCode`|`uint256`|An optional referral code|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountIn`|`uint256`|The input amount spent|
